# RavenMCP

> RavenMCP (Raven) is an open-source [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server that gives AI agents like Claude design intelligence — the design knowledge once locked in expert heads. It exposes 105 tools spanning design principles, UI patterns, design-system tokens, content voice, brand, research methods, service blueprints, business strategy, multi-platform design audits (web, iOS, Android, React Native), Raven Design (click-to-edit on the live page), a local Decision Graph for design decisions, and a Taste Engine that holds every build to the owner's own design judgment. It is free, Apache-2.0 licensed, and installs in one command.

Install with one command:

```
claude mcp add raven -- npx -y raven-mcp
```

Key facts:
- 105 focused tools, grouped by job (know, create, design, audit, judge, decide).
- Raven Design (local stdio): click any element on your running dev server, edit its tokens, styles, and layout with live preview, and package the change against your DESIGN.md for your agent. Layout structure is a template contract (fixed/flexible slots); review_diff and polish_diff check a code diff against your DESIGN.md tokens and recorded decisions, and can gate on governed decisions.
- A local Decision Graph: a queryable design-decision memory (decisions, evidence, sources) that people and coding agents both consult, with provenance on every node and supersede/scope resolution that never hard-deletes. Cold-start it from git history, Markdown, or meeting transcripts; gap_scan keeps it honest. Stays local — under your project, or ~/.raven when there's no project store.
- 129 design principles: Nielsen's heuristics, Laws of UX, Gestalt, WCAG accessibility, typography, color theory, mobile UX, responsive layout, and the D4D framework — each with violations and checklists.
- 22 reusable UI patterns.
- 12 named design systems with production tokens in W3C DTCG format.
- Audits for web pages, layouts, SwiftUI/iOS screens, Android, and React Native — checking principles, patterns, contrast, tap targets, typography, and accessibility.
- Content voice guides, brand profiles, research methods, and service blueprints.
- A Taste Engine that makes a person's design judgment portable: calibrate a profile once, then audit_taste returns a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict on any build, citing the rule_id and evidence behind every finding — and learning from your corrections. Profiles stay local under ~/.raven/taste.
- Cinematic build recipes that name their paid external dependency (e.g. the Higgsfield MCP) and a still-photography fallback, so the agent confirms any spend with you before running it.
- 100% free and open source. No tiers, no limits, no account required.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://ravenmcp.ai/docs): Full tool reference, installation, and usage for every Raven tool.
- [Design systems](https://ravenmcp.ai/design-system): The 12 queryable design systems and their token coverage.
- [Changelog](https://ravenmcp.ai/changelog): Release history and what changed in each version.

## About

- [Homepage](https://ravenmcp.ai/): Overview of Raven Design, the Taste Engine, the Decision Graph, the knowledge layers, the 105 tools, and live examples.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/rhinocap/raven-mcp): Source code, issues, and contribution guide (Apache-2.0 license).

## Examples

- [SaaS demo](https://ravenmcp.ai/demos/saas.html): A site built entirely with Raven's design intelligence.
- [Coffee shop demo](https://ravenmcp.ai/demos/coffee-shop.html): Local-business landing page built with Raven.
- [Fitness demo](https://ravenmcp.ai/demos/fitness.html): Fitness brand site built with Raven.
- [Law firm demo](https://ravenmcp.ai/demos/law-firm.html): Professional-services site built with Raven.
- [Real estate demo](https://ravenmcp.ai/demos/real-estate.html): Property listing site built with Raven.
- [Wedding demo](https://ravenmcp.ai/demos/wedding.html): Event site built with Raven.
